correctedCommands.label: filesystem
correctedCommands.command:
cd '/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite-wt/herdr-resume-01a097f8' || exit 1
qa_root=$(mktemp -d "/tmp/ferryx-parent-q-filesystem-XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'status=$?; rm -rf -- "$qa_root"; cleanup=$?; if [ "$cleanup" -ne 0 ] || [ -e "$qa_root" ]; then printf "PARENT_Q_CLEANUP_FAILED root=%s\n" "$qa_root"; exit 1; fi; printf "PARENT_Q_COMPLETE filesystem exit=%s root=%s absent=true\n" "$status" "$qa_root"; exit "$status"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$qa_root/home" "$qa_root/runtime" "$qa_root/data" "$qa_root/sessions" "$qa_root/tmp" "$qa_root/config" "$qa_root/xdg-data" "$qa_root/cache" || exit 1
HOME="$qa_root/home" FERRYX_RUNTIME_DIR="$qa_root/runtime" FERRYX_DATA_DIR="$qa_root/data" FERRYX_SESSION_DIR="$qa_root/sessions" TMPDIR="$qa_root/tmp" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$qa_root/config" XDG_DATA_HOME="$qa_root/xdg-data" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$qa_root/cache" CARGO_HOME=/Users/indo/.cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/Users/indo/.rustup CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUSTC_WRAPPER= CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/src-tauri/target" /Users/indo/.cargo/bin/cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --lib remote::filesystem -- --nocapture
